channel.title: Perch
channel.description: Updates for Perch, a tiny floating todo list for the Mac.

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
• New: Match System. In Settings > Theme > Appearance, pick one theme for macOS Light and one for macOS Dark. Perch switches when macOS does.
  • New: a quiet tick when you save a new todo. The Sound switch turns it off with the completion click.
  • The panel now moves up when new todos would push it under the Dock.
  • The Settings window now stays on screen when a taller tab opens.
